projectSummary: Direct measured attachment evidence for the abdominal part, located against a named bony landmark.

publication.statusSource: Crossref REST API works record plus the Crossref/Retraction Watch CSV export, both fetched 2026-09-13

notes: Abstract-only; a single-ancestry cadaveric sample, which the paper itself states.

study.intervention: Cadaveric morphometry and tensile testing of the abdominal head.
study.population: In 20 hemithoraxes of fresh Korean cadavers, the width, thickness and location of the origin of the abdominal head of the pectoralis major were measured in relation to the seventh rib-costal cartilage junction, and a force gauge measured the force needed to detach the abdominal head from its origin.

title: Anatomy and tensile strength of the abdominal head of the pectoralis major muscle in relation to transaxillary breast augmentation.
